_comment: Reference catalog of Claude Code hooks in the REAL .claude/settings.json shape. The bootstrap skill copies the entries matching the detected stack into the project's .claude/settings.json (merging into any existing hooks). Every command reads the hook JSON from stdin and parses it with jq — the env vars $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS / $CLAUDE_COMMAND DO NOT EXIST. Path var that exists: ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}. Timeouts are in SECONDS. PostToolUse entries inject context via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext; PreToolUse blockers deny via hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision=deny. Entry order: PostToolUse[0]=TypeScript tsc, [1]=Python py_compile, [2]=Go vet, [3]=Rust cargo check, [4]=Python pytest (optional/heavier), [5]=TypeScript build (optional/heavier). PreToolUse[0]=TS console.log commit-blocker, [1]=Python bare-except commit-blocker.

hooks.command: input=$(cat); fp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30); if [ -n "$out" ]; then msg=$(printf 'tsc --noEmit reported issues after editing %s:\n%s' "$fp" "$out"); jq -n --arg c "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$c}}'; fi;; esac

input=$(cat); fp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *.py) out=$(python3 -c 'import py_compile,sys; py_compile.compile(sys.argv[1], doraise=True)' "$fp" 2>&1 | head -10); if [ -n "$out" ]; then msg=$(printf 'py_compile failed for %s:\n%s' "$fp" "$out"); jq -n --arg c "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$c}}'; fi;; esac

input=$(cat); fp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *.go) out=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && go vet ./... 2>&1 | head -20); if [ -n "$out" ]; then msg=$(printf 'go vet reported issues after editing %s:\n%s' "$fp" "$out"); jq -n --arg c "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$c}}'; fi;; esac

input=$(cat); fp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *.rs) out=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && cargo check 2>&1 | head -30); if [ -n "$out" ]; then msg=$(printf 'cargo check reported issues after editing %s:\n%s' "$fp" "$out"); jq -n --arg c "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$c}}'; fi;; esac

input=$(cat); fp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *.py) out=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && python3 -m pytest tests/ -x --tb=short -q 2>&1 | tail -15); if [ -n "$out" ]; then msg=$(printf 'pytest run after editing %s:\n%s' "$fp" "$out"); jq -n --arg c "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$c}}'; fi;; esac

input=$(cat); fp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20); if [ -n "$out" ]; then msg=$(printf 'next build after editing %s:\n%s' "$fp" "$out"); jq -n --arg c "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$c}}'; fi;; esac

input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) hits=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && grep -rn 'console\.log' --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' src/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v '// keep' | head -5); if [ -n "$hits" ]; then msg=$(printf 'Blocked commit: console.log in TS source. Remove it or mark the line with // keep:\n%s' "$hits"); jq -n --arg r "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'; fi;; esac

input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) hits=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && grep -rnE 'except *:' --include='*.py' . 2>/dev/null | head -5); if [ -n "$hits" ]; then msg=$(printf 'Blocked commit: bare except found. Catch a specific exception and handle it:\n%s' "$hits"); jq -n --arg r "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'; fi;; esac
